title: 8 Fights a Godly Man Picks With His Phone Before Breakfast
caption:
His grandfather never fought this battle. He fights it every day before breakfast.

The phone is where lust lives, where envy lives, where his time actually dies. Managing it doesn't work. It has to be fought on purpose, starting with the first hour of the day.

Pick one fight from this list and pick it again tomorrow.
